integrity: The infinite theorem is supported by a symbolic inverse-interval potential proof. Finite checker is corroborative. Originality and significance are self-review assessments, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicit two-letter cyclic/parity family; no universal bound, no extension to a different parity map. The numerical odd-degree polynomial is also known for a structurally different Eulerian family; no numerical-priority claim is made. Original Gusev full text unavailable through accessible routes, but its transition rules and proof are reproduced in a fully inspected public technical account.
title: An exact parity dichotomy for cyclic automata with alternating successor collapse
